observations.text_or_visual_description: A printed page from a poetry book titled 'Between Heaven And Earth'. The poem is titled 'Love That Needs a Reason Won't Last'. It includes the text: 'If you fall in love with someone because they make you laugh, what happens when their jokes no longer make you smile? ... Love built on conditions is love that won't last.' The footer attributes the poem: 'Poet, TheFallen. Between Heaven And Earth: Poems about Losing & Finding Yourself (p.74). (Function). Kindle Edition.'
